vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill

The skill bundle provides instructions for an AI agent to use the `asc` command-line tool for Apple App Store Connect release workflows. All commands listed in `SKILL.md` are standard operations for uploading builds, distributing to TestFlight, and submitting to the App Store. There is no evidence of prompt injection, data exfiltration, malicious execution, persistence mechanisms, or obfuscation. The requirement for `ASC_*` environment variables is for the legitimate operation of the `asc` tool, not for exfiltration.
